personal.name: Yulius Giann
personal.title: Part-time CTO
personal.bio: I've spent 10+ years building software. Today I'm a Software Engineer Lead at Kompas.id, and I work with business owners as their part-time CTO. I listen to how the business runs, decide what's worth building, build it, and stay around to keep it working.

services.title: Turn your business into a plan
services.description: Your WhatsApp orders, spreadsheets and paper forms, mapped into a written scope with a price.

services.title: Build the software
services.description: Booking systems, dashboards and online payments, built around how your business already works.

services.title: Make the technical calls
services.description: Hosting, tools and vendors chosen and explained in plain language. AI-built code reviewed.

services.title: Keep it running
services.description: I fix what breaks after launch. One person to call, not an IT department to hire.

process.title: Free 30-minute call
process.description: Tell me how your business runs and where it gets stuck.

process.title: Written scope and price
process.description: You see what gets built, in what order, and what it costs before any work starts.

process.title: Build in stages

process.title: Launch and handover

process.title: Ongoing support

projects.title: Rentalnow.id
projects.problem: The owner tracked bikes and bookings through WhatsApp chats and paper notes. There was no single place to see which bikes were free or due for service.
projects.outcome: One dashboard runs 3 branches and 42 motorcycles: orders, availability, and a booking calendar, with every oil change, tyre, and battery logged. Since launch in August 2025 it has handled 1,300+ bookings, and monthly bookings have more than doubled this year. Customers book online at rentalnow.id.

projects.title: PROPHACKJAPAN
projects.problem: Listings lived in a spreadsheet, so buyers could not browse or search them on their own.
projects.outcome: 773 listings are now published on a searchable site, with 467 live and 294 marked sold. Since the public launch in August 2026, 160+ buyers have signed up, and signups have grown every month: 27, then 52, then 94 in October. Their team now builds new features themselves with AI coding tools, and I review each one as their technical advisor.

testimonial.quote: Mr. Yulius has been instrumental in the system’s foundational design—specifically regarding database development, the selection and integration of various tools and services, and the establishment of protocols for data exchange. His insights and proposals for strengthening security, along with his precise, well-founded advice, have served as an invaluable source of support. Mr. Yulius approaches his work with great integrity; he consistently grasps our intentions—even when we lack technical expertise—and responds in a timely manner. This ensures that our project progresses smoothly, even though we work from different locations.

faq.question: What does a part-time CTO actually do?
faq.answer: The same job a full-time CTO does, for the hours your business needs: deciding what to build, choosing the technology, building it, and keeping it running.

faq.question: Our team already builds with AI. Why would we need you?
faq.answer: AI writes code fast. It also writes security holes, slow pages, and payment bugs without warning you. I review each feature your team builds, the way I do for PROPHACKJAPAN, so you keep the speed and catch the problems early.

faq.question: I'm not technical. Can we still work together?
faq.answer: Yes. You explain how the business works. I handle the technical side and explain each decision in plain language before we make it.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Each project is priced per stage. After our first call you get a written scope with a fixed price for each stage. Support after launch is a separate monthly retainer.

faq.question: How long until it's live?
faq.answer: The timeline comes with the written scope, split into stages so you can start using parts of the system early.

faq.question: Who looks after it after launch?
faq.answer: I do, through an optional monthly retainer that covers bug fixes and technical advice. If you have your own team, I hand it over with step-by-step guides for every feature and setup instructions so your developers can run it themselves.

faq.question: Do I own the code and data?
faq.answer: Yes. The code, domain, hosting accounts, and data are registered in your name.

faq.question: We already have a system or an agency. Can you help?
faq.answer: Yes. I can review what you have, fix what's broken, or join vendor meetings as your technical advisor.
